title: Login with valid credentials
description: As a registered user I want to sign in with my email and password so that I can write articles and comment.
acceptance_criteria: Given a registered email and matching password, the user is signed in
After signing in the user is redirected to the home page
The navbar shows the username instead of the Sign in link

title: Login with wrong password
description: When the password does not match the account, sign-in is rejected and the reason is shown on the login form.
acceptance_criteria: The API responds with 401 and the error 'credentials invalid'
The error message is shown above the form
The user stays on the login page and the password field keeps focus

title: Register a new account
description: A visitor can create an account with a username, email address and password from the Sign up page.
acceptance_criteria: Username, email and password are required
After registering the user is signed in and taken to the home page

title: Prevent duplicate usernames and emails at sign-up
description: Two accounts must never share the same username or email address.
acceptance_criteria: Registering with a taken username returns 409 'username has already been taken'
Registering with a taken email returns 409 'email has already been taken'
The form shows the conflict error and keeps the entered values

title: Password must be at least 8 characters
description: Short passwords are rejected on registration and when changing the password in settings.
acceptance_criteria: A password with fewer than 8 characters returns 422
A password with exactly 8 characters is accepted

title: Log out from the settings page
description: A signed-in user ends their session with the logout button at the bottom of Settings.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking 'Or click here to logout' removes the stored JWT
The user is taken to the home page and the navbar shows Sign in

title: Update profile settings
description: Users can change their profile image URL, bio, username and email on the Settings page.
acceptance_criteria: Saved changes are visible on the user's profile page
An empty bio is stored as no bio

title: Global feed shows newest articles first with pagination
description: The Global Feed tab on the home page lists all articles, most recent first, ten per page.
acceptance_criteria: Articles are ordered by creation date, newest first
Each page shows at most 10 articles
Page buttons below the list move between pages

title: Your Feed shows articles from followed authors
description: Signed-in users get a Your Feed tab listing only articles written by authors they follow.
acceptance_criteria: Articles from authors the user does not follow are not listed
The tab is only visible when signed in

title: Filter articles by tag
description: Clicking a tag in the Popular Tags sidebar shows only articles with that tag.
acceptance_criteria: The URL changes to /tag/<tag>
A tab with the tag name becomes active
Only articles containing that tag are listed

title: Create an article with markdown and tags
description: Signed-in users write articles in the editor with a title, a short description, a markdown body and tags.
acceptance_criteria: Title, description and body are required
Tags are added by pressing Enter in the tags field
The markdown body is rendered as HTML on the article page

title: Only the author can edit or delete an article
description: Edit and delete actions are restricted to the person who wrote the article.
acceptance_criteria: Edit Article and Delete Article buttons are only shown to the author
Updating or deleting someone else's article returns 403

title: Favorite and unfavorite an article
description: Signed-in users mark articles as favorites with the heart button, and the favorites count updates.
acceptance_criteria: Favoriting increases the counter by one and the button switches to Unfavorite
Unfavoriting decreases the counter by one
Favorited articles appear on the user's Favorited Articles tab

title: Follow and unfollow users from their profile
description: The profile page has a Follow button so users can subscribe to another author.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking Follow switches the button to Unfollow
Following is not possible when signed out

title: Add and delete comments on an article
description: Signed-in users post comments under an article and can remove their own comments.
acceptance_criteria: A new comment appears at the top of the comment list
The trash icon is only shown on the user's own comments
Deleting someone else's comment returns 403

title: Expired session is not detected
description: After the JWT expires the app still shows the user as signed in, and every action fails with 401 without explanation.
acceptance_criteria: When the API returns 401 for an expired token, the token is cleared
The user is sent to the login page with a message that the session ended

title: Articles with the same title get the same slug
description: Publishing a second article with an existing title fails because both would get the same URL slug.
acceptance_criteria: The second article gets a unique slug with a short suffix
Both articles open at their own URL

title: Empty state for feeds without articles
description: When a feed or tag has no articles, a friendly message is shown instead of a blank area.
acceptance_criteria: The Global Feed shows 'No articles are here... yet.'
Your Feed suggests following users or visiting the Global Feed
